A bit about us

Located in Canggu and Ubud, Two Face is a vibrant space that brings together locals and travelers over great coffee, creative brunch dishes and a welcoming atmosphere. Two Face offers a cozy retreat for breakfast lovers, remote workers, and coffee enthusiasts alike. With a dedicated team and a warm, relaxed vibe, Two Face invites guests to linger, unwind, or get productive in a true Bali setting.
